subject: Film & Cinema
title: Editing for Emotion vs. Information
description: A short lesson to help you apply Editing for Emotion vs. Information.

hook.text: Some cuts tell you what's happening. The best cuts tell you how to feel about it.

buildup.text: Informational editing delivers plot — who, what, where. Emotional editing delivers feeling.

discovery.text: The Kuleshov effect proved that the same face, paired with different images, conveys different emotions.

twist.text: Hollywood often prioritizes clarity over emotion. The best editors refuse to choose.

climax.text: Editing is not about assembling footage. It's about orchestrating feeling.

quiz.question: What did the Kuleshov effect demonstrate?
options: The same face paired with different images conveys different emotions
